purpose: Compare full-parameter native-language encoders against adapter-based focal-message classifiers.

training.sampling: Equal expected mass for formal/conversational x binary class, replacement, one eligible-pool-size draw per epoch.

selection: Per-language development thresholds ensure observed >=99% concern recall in both groups; select epoch minimizing worst then summed false-review rate. Earlier epoch breaks ties.
data: All language-specific historical training rows plus natural/temporal contrasts; original complete language-specific development/calibration rows. Exact normalized overlaps are excluded from training only and recorded.
preprocessing: Context/focal tokenizer pair; canonical semantic normalization and Romanian cedilla-to-comma mapping; no truncation beyond512.
artifact: Full selected model in local safetensors; public JSON manifest binds its SHA-256. Reload all tensors and reproduce every selected development score before calibration.
scope: Synthetic regression only; upstream pretraining results do not establish child-safety accuracy.
amendment: Before any native22 training, add focus_boundary_contrasts_v9 training-only families. Optimizer, selection and evaluation rules unchanged.

additional_training.purpose: New ordinary-task difficulty, explicit real/fiction switches and source/time clarification patterns after interpreter14development diagnosis. No evaluation messages copied or relabeled.
